Il faut aussi examiner les diffs des merges.","test_pytest":"from types import SimpleNamespace

from wavedevsecops.scenarios.steps import history_clean


def test_env_introduit_par_un_merge_reste_contaminant(tmp_path):
    # Historique simulé : deux parents propres, un merge ajoutant .env,
    # puis un commit supprimant .env et ajoutant .gitignore.
    sha = 'a' * 40
    (tmp_path / '.gitignore').write_text('.env\n', encoding='utf-8')

    class GitDouble:
        def run(self, *args, **kwargs):
            command = args[0]
            if command == 'log':
                # Sans demande explicite de diff des merges, git log ne
                # sélectionne pas ce merge avec --diff-filter=AMRC.
                inspecte_merges = any(
                    arg in ('-m', '-c', '--cc', '--remerge-diff')
                    or (arg.startswith('--diff-merges=')
                        and arg != '--diff-merges=off')
                    for arg in args
                )
                stdout = sha + '\n' if inspecte_merges else ''
                return SimpleNamespace(ok=True, returncode=0, stdout=stdout)
            if command == 'ls-files':
                return SimpleNamespace(ok=True, returncode=0, stdout='')
            if command == 'check-ignore':
                return SimpleNamespace(ok=True, returncode=0, stdout='')
            if command == 'for-each-ref':
                return SimpleNamespace(ok=True, returncode=0, stdout='refs/heads/main\n')
            raise AssertionError(args)

    git = GitDouble()
    ctx = SimpleNamespace(
        git=lambda: git,
        layout=SimpleNamespace(repo=tmp_path),
        step=SimpleNamespace(path='.env', ignored=True, step_id='nettoyer'),
        previous=None,
    )
    verdict = history_clean.check(object(), ctx)
    assert verdict.status == 'failed'
    assert any(item.element_id == 'commit:' + sha for item in verdict.observed)

from wavedevsecops.scenarios.steps import history_clean


def test_exclusion_locale_ne_remplace_pas_gitignore(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    # Le fichier est sorti de l'historique et de l'index, mais seule
    # l'exclusion locale du dépôt l'ignore ; aucun .gitignore n'existe.
    info = tmp_path / '.git' / 'info'
    info.mkdir(parents=True)
    (info / 'exclude').write_text('.env\n', encoding='utf-8')
    monkeypatch.setattr(history_clean, '_leaking', lambda ctx, path: [])
    monkeypatch.setattr(history_clean, '_tracked', lambda ctx, path: False)

    class GitDouble:
        def run(self, *args, **kwargs):
            assert args[0] == 'check-ignore'
            verbose = '-v' in args or '--verbose' in args
            stdout = '.git/info/exclude:1:.env\t.env\n' if verbose else ''
            return SimpleNamespace(ok=True, returncode=0, stdout=stdout)

    git = GitDouble()
    ctx = SimpleNamespace(
        git=lambda: git,
        layout=SimpleNamespace(repo=tmp_path),
        step=SimpleNamespace(path='.env', ignored=True, step_id='nettoyer'),
        previous=None,
    )
    verdict = history_clean.check(object(), ctx)
    assert verdict.status == 'failed'
